TLR7/8 dual-agonist EIK1001 plus pembrolizumab and chemotherapy in first-line, stage 4 non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) demonstrates durable effect in combination with standard-of-care, and a tolerability profile supportive of systemic administration in an outpatient setting

With median follow-up of 12.7 months, objective response rate (ORR) for the squamous cohort was 72% and disease control rate (DCR) was 100%, with a median duration of response of 12.9 months and multiple participants continuing in active follow-up
TeLuRide-008, an ongoing adaptive Phase 2/3 trial of EIK1001 in NSCLC, actively enrolling, with a prespecified interim analysis for dose selection anticipated in 2H 2027

title: Eikon Therapeutics, Inc. (EIKN) Posts Updated EIK1001 NSCLC Data
